prompt.en: 70,000 currency plus Bitcoin falling from 30,000 to 15,000, with sale cost 1,000, yields what?
prompt.sw: Sarafu 70,000 na Bitcoin kutoka 30,000 hadi 15,000, gharama ya kuuza 1,000, vinatoa kiasi gani?

explanation.sw: 70,000 + 15,000 − 1,000 = 84,000 chini ya dhana za mauzo za kubuni.

prompt.en: Conversion is unavailable until after an 80,000 payout. With 70,000 accessible, timely shortfall?
prompt.sw: Kubadilisha hakupatikani kabla ya malipo ya 80,000. Zinapatikana 70,000. Pengo la wakati?

label.en: No shortfall because assets have value
label.sw: Hakuna pengo kwa sababu mali zina thamani

explanation.en: Quoted value is different from resources that can actually settle the obligation on time.
explanation.sw: Thamani ya bei ni tofauti na rasilimali zinazolipa wajibu kwa wakati.

prompt.en: What does a public treasury balance not establish?
prompt.sw: Salio la hazina la umma halithibitishi nini?

label.en: The absence of hidden member liabilities
label.sw: Kutokuwepo kwa madeni yaliyofichwa kwa wanachama

explanation.en: Assets alone do not show all obligations or authorize an experiment.
explanation.sw: Mali pekee hazionyeshi wajibu wote wala kuidhinisha jaribio.

prompt.en: When can a paper-only Bitcoin experiment be a responsible result?
prompt.sw: Jaribio la Bitcoin la karatasi pekee linaweza kuwa uamuzi wenye wajibu lini?

label.en: Never; every group must deposit funds
label.sw: Kamwe; kila kikundi lazima kiweke pesa

label.en: When real obligations, consent or recovery make live exposure inappropriate
label.sw: Wajibu halisi, ridhaa au urejeshaji vikifanya hatari halisi isifae

explanation.en: Learning does not require risking essential group contributions.
explanation.sw: Kujifunza hakuhitaji kuweka michango muhimu hatarini.
